images.filename: Part of the Welbeck Estate buildings - geograph.org.uk - 1176113.jpg
images.caption: Part of the Welbeck Estate buildings A bronze plaque in the middle of the long wall commemorates the St John's Ambulance Brigade's (Welbeck Division) service in the Boer War. I presume the archway on the right is an entrance to one of the famous Welbeck tunnels.
images.alt: Part of the Welbeck Estate buildings A bronze plaque in the middle of the long wall commemorates the St John's Ambulance Brigade's (Welbeck Division) service in the Boer War. I presume the archway on the right is an entrance to one of the famous Welbeck tunnels.
categories: Images from Geograph Britain and Ireland

images.filename: The 'new' riding school, Welbeck Estate - geograph.org.uk - 1176172.jpg
images.caption: The 'new' riding school, Welbeck Estate Built by the 5th Duke of Portland in the 1860s, and said to be second only in size to the Spanish Riding School in Vienna.
images.alt: The 'new' riding school, Welbeck Estate Built by the 5th Duke of Portland in the 1860s, and said to be second only in size to the Spanish Riding School in Vienna.
